causes.label: Fill hoses or drain hose is improperly connected
remedies: Make sure hose connections are tight at faucets and rubber washers are installed.
Make sure end of drain hose is correctly inserted in and secured to drain facility.

causes.label: Household drain may be clogged
remedies: Check household plumbing.
You may need to call a plumber.

causes.label: Drain hose rubs on wall
remedies: Make sure drain hose does not make contact with the wall.
May cause excessive wear on the hose.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 11: "Drain hose rubs on wall"

causes.label: Constant water pressure to the fill hoses at the water source
remedies: Tighten hoses at the faucets.
Check condition of the fill hoses; they should be replaced every 5 years.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 11: "Constant water pressure to the fill hoses at the water source"

causes.label: Cooler water temperatures provide improved energy efficiency
remedies: New laundry detergents have been formulated to work with cooler water temperatures without affecting wash performance.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 11: "Cooler water temperatures provide improved energy efficiency"

causes.label: Water supply is turned off or improperly connected
remedies: Turn both hot and cold faucets fully on and make sure hoses are connected to correct faucets.
NOTE: Water valves are marked “H” and “C” and internal valve screens are color coded.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 11: "Water supply is turned off or improperly connected"

causes.label: Water valve screens are stopped up
remedies: Turn off the water source and remove the water connection hoses from the upper back of the washer.
Use a brush or toothpick to clean the screens in the machine.
Reconnect the hoses and turn the water back on.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 11: "Water valve screens are stopped up"

causes.label: Cool/Cold Water when selecting Hot
remedies: This is normal.

causes.label: Shifting mechanism is disengaging the motor
remedies: When the machine is manually turned off, the shifter will disengage the motor before completely shutting down.
If lid is raised before the motor is disengaged, it will resume when lid is closed.

causes.label: Basket moves or rotates freely
remedies: Washer basket does not have a traditional brake.

causes.label: Incorrect cycle selected.
remedies: Make sure the cycle selected matches the load you are washing.

symptoms.symptom: Blinking Spin light or Spin light on at end of cycle

remedies: Allow cycle to continue and finish.
If load is wet at the end of the cycle, even out load and run a Drain & Spin cycle.

causes.label: Incorrect use of fabric softener
remedies: Check fabric softener package for instructions and follow directions for using dispenser.
